# Backup {visibility="uncounted"}

## On top of DifferentiationInterfaceTest {visibility="uncounted"}

- DifferentiationInterfaceTest works per function and per package. We
  added a registry where a package declares which scenarios are broken
  on which backend, and `check_broken` re-runs them
- A scenario declared broken that starts passing is flagged, so the
  declarations cannot go stale
- `gamma_inc` and `beta_inc` carry no automatic differentiation rules,
  so we hand-wrote those
  derivatives. `ScoringRules.jl` hit the same two from scratch

::: {.attribution}
`src/ad_harness.jl` in `EpiAwarePackageTools.jl` and `src/gamma_ad.jl`,
`src/beta_ad.jl` in `EpiAwareADTools.jl`, read 2026-08-11.
:::

## Agents on the outbreak model {visibility="uncounted"}

- On the live DRC outbreak model the tests were written by the same
  agents that wrote the code. A green suite says the code does what it
  was told, not that what it was told was right
- Its chart digitiser undercounted one situation report by **54%** after
  a change in image compression. A self-check caught it, not a person
- **1,144 pull requests** in the EpiAware org from the bot account, all
  time. 966 merged, 119 closed unmerged, the same ratio as my other
  organisations

::: {.attribution}
EpiAware counts from `gh api search/issues`, read 2026-08-10 · the
digitiser error rate and the two pipeline breaks are in `data/README.md`
in [BVDOutbreakSize](https://github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize),
read 2026-08-08.
:::

## Why we rolled our own template {visibility="uncounted"}

- `PkgTemplates.jl` composes the plugins you pick. `BestieTemplate.jl`
  is a Copier template, applied to an existing package a feature at a
  time
- Both are built to be chosen from. We wanted every package identical,
  so that whatever writes the next one has one shape to copy
- Neither covers the opinionated part, per-backend automatic
  differentiation testing and
  benchmarking

::: {.attribution}
[BestieTemplate.jl](https://github.com/JuliaBesties/BestieTemplate.jl)
and [PkgTemplates.jl](https://github.com/JuliaCI/PkgTemplates.jl), read
2026-08-11.
:::

## Enzyme on the joint model {visibility="uncounted"}

- Enzyme is an opt-in package extension. Every fit in the repository uses
  Mooncake unless the caller asks for something else
- On a single stream Enzyme matches Mooncake to `maxabsdiff = 4.44e-15`.
  On the joint it is `@test_broken`
- Two failures. Reverse mode could not build a shadow for the closures
  `map(collection) do x … end` makes when the captures are boxed, which we
  fixed, and under that an `EnzymeInternalError` in Enzyme's own
  `nodecayed_phis!` pass
- Julia 1.12.6, Enzyme 0.13.190, Mooncake 0.5.39, Turing 0.46

::: {.attribution}
